note: UI-derived inventory of business actions. api_status: covered = a public API action performs it; partial = API performs part of it (e.g. scheduling via a field); ui_only = no public API action exists. related_api_action must resolve to an action id in the generated catalog (validated by scripts/validate.mjs).
